data.narrative:
Neko Health is a Series C–stage biotech and health company that has raised $326M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 3 public equities (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers in the Biotech & Health sector, with direct comparables including Colossal Biosciences ($10.3B Series C), Chai Discovery ($3.8B Series C), and New Limit ($3.1B Series C).

Two valuation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis, using $700M in total raised as a proxy base value and applying a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical of Series C advancement, implies $1.2B. Peer-median analysis across the 3 same-sector, same-stage comparables yields a median valuation of $3.8B, with a range of $3.1B to $10.3B. Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied due to absence of disclosed revenue for the private target. The public sector median P/S of 6.6x is therefore unusable.

Triangulation of the two applicable methods produces a low of $1.0B, median of $2.5B, and high of $4.4B. Key uncertainties include the wide dispersion within the peer set ($3.1B–$10.3B) and whether Neko Health's operational metrics and clinical/commercial trajectory more closely track the floor or ceiling of comparable valuations. Revenue scale and near-term milestones will be material to range placement.
